claim_boundary: This policy derives a candidate model-role map from the preregistered E001 evidence. It does not qualify dynamics or assert that the modeled sensory drive equals measured activity in these neurons. hDeltaC is treated as a structural convergence candidate only; the original VT062617 functional attribution is confounded by hDeltaK labeling.

side_inference.ambiguous_policy: exclude from side-specific model roles and report
side_inference.rationale: Direct ventral-PFN recordings show airflow preference tied to the hemisphere containing the cell body. MaleCNS somaSide is therefore the primary laterality authority; rootSide and instance remain explicitly weaker anatomical fallbacks.

odor_context_left.rationale: FB5AB is an E001 literature-anchored olfactory-navigation input candidate; task v1 deliberately imposes the same nondirectional odor-context value bilaterally. The injected scalar is a model abstraction, not measured MaleCNS FB5AB activity.

odor_context_right.rationale: Right-side counterpart of the tied bilateral FB5AB model odor-context role.

wind_basis_left.rationale: Retained ventral-PFN source neurons assigned to the left model airflow basis. Soma-side assignment has direct literature support; rootSide or instance are weaker anatomical fallbacks and must remain identifiable in the review artifact. Role membership does not assert identical physiology across PFN subtypes.

wind_basis_right.rationale: Right-side counterpart of the side-resolved retained ventral-PFN model basis population, with the same evidence hierarchy and subtype caveats.

steer_left.rationale: Left DNa02 is a literature-supported bilateral steering readout candidate; direct recordings show ipsilateral DNa02 activity preceding and covarying with ipsilateral turning. This does not imply DNa02 alone determines turning.

steer_right.rationale: Right counterpart of the DNa02 steering readout, under the same functional boundary.

integration_hdelta_c.rationale: Exact hDeltaC body IDs retained by odor-input, PFN-input, and outgoing PFL3 stages. This qualifies body-ID-continuous structural convergence only. It must not be used as hDeltaC-specific physiological evidence because the original VT062617 functional experiments are confounded by hDeltaK labeling.

pfl3_output.rationale: Exact PFL3 body IDs continuous across the hDeltaC-to-PFL3 and PFL3-to-DNa02 stages. Continuity is structural and does not establish the modeled transfer function or steering-output side. PFL3 steering laterality requires LAL projection evidence or qualified perturbation/readout behavior.

wind_unresolved_policy.reason: The optimizer must not invent hemisphere assignments for any retained PFN whose somaSide, rootSide, and instance evidence all fail to resolve side.

required_before_training: no body ID appears in both left and right versions of the same role family
exact role IDs and side evidence source are persisted
intermediate-type composition is summarized for each primary E001 stage
sign coverage is computed on the eventual candidate GraphBundle
review artifact is frozen before real optimization
